verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, and setting up autonomous background automations is a software or OS capability, so the question does not fit this kind of product. The only 'background' mention describes cloud uploads running alongside creative apps, which is about multitasking performance, not user-configurable automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
